dedupe_keys.name: upgrade e us household residential energy decisions survey

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes UPGRADE-E, a United States survey of residential energy decisions. The own DataHub page identifies a public second version and CC0 terms. The describing article reports 9,919 responses across 391 variables, with household and building characteristics, completed modifications, technology willingness, motivations, barriers and information sources. The package has fourteen data files, a dictionary, survey questions, README and an R script to combine respondent records. Public access is free. These observations can parameterize household adoption and retrofit choices in agent-based or building-energy simulations, with model-energyplus a related technical building context. A caveat is that self-reported choices and intentions do not prove later installation or measured energy savings. Survey weights, nonresponse and small subgroup counts need review before extrapolating nationally. The own DataHub page and article Data Records were read without downloading respondent files or running the merge script.
